title: Infernal Affairs III
description: Ten months after the murder of Yan, Ming is set to work on mundane office duties; Yeung reminds Ming of his own suspicious rise to fame.

title: Once Upon a Time in China
description: A man (Jet Li) must protect his martial-arts school while sorting out his feelings for a young woman (Biao Yuen) who is his aunt by adoption.

title: Once Upon a Time in China II
description: A martial arts teacher (Jet Li) protects his students and his aunt (Rosamund Kwan) from a mercenary.

title: Once Upon a Time in China III
description: A martial-arts master (Jet Li) defends his father from several gangs during a competition in Beijing.

title: Once Upon a Time in China
description: A man (Jet Li) must protect his martial-arts school while sorting out his feelings for a young woman (Biao Yuen) who is his aunt by adoption.

title: Winners and Sinners
description: Five criminals who have just been released from prison vow to never commit a crime again. However, after opening a cleaning company, they get entangled in a gang war.

title: Police Story
description: A kung-fu policeman must protect a female witness from a Hong Kong drug lord for whom she used to work.

title: JCVD
description: Weary action star Jean-Claude Van Damme (Jean-Claude Van Damme) returns to Belgium to find relief from his troubles but instead stumbles into a bank robbery.

title: City Hunter
description: U.S. criminals hijack a cruise ship with a gluttonous private eye (Jackie Chan) aboard who is seeking a magnate's missing daughter.

title: Hard-Boiled
description: A police officer and an undercover colleague embark on a blood-splattered quest to crush a gun smuggling ring.

title: Battle Creek Brawl
description: In the 1930s, an effete Chicago mobster (Jose Ferrer) pits a Chinese kicker (Jackie Chan) against a king-size brute called Kiss.

title: The Bodyguard From Beijing
description: A bodyguard's assignment to safeguard a murder witness is complicated by the growing love between them.

title: Prison on Fire
description: Sentenced to two years for accidentally killing a robber, a man (Tony Leung Ka Fai) befriends another prisoner (Chow Yun-Fat) who helps protect him.

title: Prison on Fire 2
description: Ching escapes from prison to see his young son who has been put in an orphanage.

title: Brotherhood of the Wolf
description: In 18th-century France, the Chevalier de Fronsac and his Native American friend Mani are sent to the Gevaudan province at the king's behest to investigate the killings of hundreds by a mysterious beast.

title: Living in Oblivion
description: A harried director must contend with technical foul-ups and actors' shenanigans on the set of a low-budget film.

title: Red Headed Stranger
description: Revisionist western about fallen preacher Shay, who guns down his wife Raysha for running off with another man. Wandering, he meets single mom Laurie; however, helpless sheriff Scoby wants Shay to help him fight the villainous Clavers.

title: Journey to the End of the Night
description: A man (Brendan Fraser) hatches a scheme to double-cross his father (Scott Glenn) and steal money from a drug deal.

title: Hopscotch
description: An ex-CIA agent (Walter Matthau) and his lover (Glenda Jackson) write a book about the agency, one jump ahead of agents sent to stop them.

title: Today You Die
description: A world-class thief (Steven Seagal) escapes from prison to exact revenge on the partners who doubled-crossed him.

title: The Infiltrator
description: In 1986, federal agent Robert Mazur poses as a money-laundering businessman to infiltrate the trafficking network of Colombian drug kingpin Pablo Escobar.

title: Once Upon a Time in China III
description: A martial-arts master (Jet Li) defends his father from several gangs during a competition in Beijing.

title: Legacy of Rage
description: Sentenced to prison for a crime he did not commit, a man sets out for revenge after his release from jail.

title: Misbehaviour
description: A team of women hatches a plan to disrupt the 1970 Miss World beauty competition in London.

title: The Devil Bat
description: A crazed chemist uses mutated bats to gain vengeance against the businessmen who prospered from his work.

title: Filly Brown
description: Majo Tonorio (Gina Rodriguez), a talented hip-hop artist, is offered a record deal from a sleazy producer. She faces a difficult choice between selling out for money or staying true to herself and her music.

title: The Gambler III: The Legend Continues
description:
S01 E01
An Old West poker player, his partner and a schoolmarm help Dakota Indians thwart a senator's land-grab.

title: Lazy Susan
description: Susan is a self-centered woman who lazily skates through life with the grudging support of her increasingly estranged family. Realizing she's middle-aged with no job and no relationship, Susan finally decides to take charge and turn things around.

title: Day of the Dead
description: The living dead regroup above while humans (Lori Cardille, Terry Alexander, Joseph Pilato) sweat it out below in a Florida missile silo.

title: Two Thousand and None
description: After learning, he has only five weeks to live, a paleontologist begins to discover the joys of life.

title: Timecop
description: In 1994 a 2004 Washington policeman (Jean-Claude Van Damme) saves his wife (Mia Sara) and stops a sinister senator from buying the presidency.

title: A Midnight Clear
description: A young GI (Ethan Hawke) and his squad have a strange encounter with Germans in the Ardennes forest, December 1944.

title: Before the Devil Knows You're Dead
description: Events spiral out of control when a man (Philip Seymour Hoffman) ropes his brother (Ethan Hawke) into a scheme to rob their parents' jewelry store.

title: A Room With a View
description: An English miss (Helena Bonham-Carter) tours 1907 Florence, Italy, with her cousin (Maggie Smith) and meets a soulmate (Julian Sands).

title: Coffee and Cigarettes
description: Vignettes revolve around a dentist appointment, a talkative waiter, musicians and celebrities.

title: The TV Set
description: A network picks up Mike Klein's (David Duchovny) pilot for a TV series, and now he must navigate through one incompetent executive after another, hoping the concept of the show still bears some resemblance to his original idea.

title: Wild Side
description: A banker who moonlights as a call-girl falls in with a sadistic undercover officer (Steven Bauer), a money launderer (Christopher Walken) and his wife (Joan Chen).

title: Assault on Precinct 13
description: Cops and convicts join forces to defend a barren police station from a vengeance-seeking street gang.

title: Karate Killer
description: Kiba is back again, but this time he has fallen from grace and been sent to prison for all the violent acts he has committed. Once he's out, he begins working as a bodyguard in a club that is crawling with gangsters.

title: Children of the Corn
description: A doctor (Peter Horton) and his girlfriend (Linda Hamilton) see no adults in a Nebraska town run by a crop of teens.

title: The Blackout: Invasion Earth
description: Life on Earth is rapidly destroyed except for a small area in Eastern Europe.

title: Chopping Mall
description: Eight teens are trapped in a shopping mall with three security robots out of control.
